answer: The whisper of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Every claim climbs the plume of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the summit re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
